blocks.text: St. Louis's Most Trusted Roof Replacement Contractors
Roof Replacement in St. Louis, MO
Professional Roof Replacement Services in St. Louis, Missouri

Your home deserves more than just any roof overhead. Whether your current roof has reached the end of its lifespan, suffered severe storm damage, or simply needs a complete upgrade, the quality of that replacement determines everything. How long your roof lasts. How well it protects your belongings. How much you spend on energy bills. How your home looks from the street. One professional replacement done right protects your family and your investment for decades. One careless replacement creates problems you'll fight for years.

When you're ready to replace your roof, you face dozens of decisions that seem overwhelming. Which shingles actually perform well in St. Louis's climate? How much ventilation does your attic really need? What underlayment provides real protection? Should you upgrade your decking? Do you need ice and water shield, and if so, where? These aren't just technical details. They're the difference between a roof that performs beautifully for 25 years and one that fails in year seven.
Why St. Louis Homeowners Need Reliable Roof Replacement

Here's what separates professional roof replacement from amateur work. The materials themselves are only half the equation. How those materials get installed matters just as much as which brand you choose. We've torn off countless roofs that used premium shingles but failed early because someone rushed the installation, skipped critical steps, or didn't understand proper flashing techniques.

St. Louis's weather demands more from your roof than most people realize. Spring thunderstorms test every shingle's impact resistance. Summer heat and humidity cycles expand and contract materials thousands of times. Fall windstorms challenge every nail's holding power. Winter ice and freeze-thaw cycles push water up under edges where poor installation leaves gaps. Your roof replacement needs to handle all of this, year after year, without compromise.
The Hidden Cost of Poor Replacement

Picture this common scenario. You hired the lowest bidder to replace your roof last year. Everything looked fine when they finished. But now you're noticing problems. Small leaks around your chimney during heavy rain. Shingles lifting at the edges on windy days. Dark streaks appearing where moisture gets trapped under improperly installed ridge vents. Your beautiful new roof is failing, and the company that installed it stopped returning your calls months ago.

Poor replacement doesn't announce itself with obvious signs on day one. It reveals itself slowly through premature failure, costly repairs, and endless frustration. By the time you realize something's wrong, your warranty claims get denied because "improper installation voids coverage." You're stuck paying twice for the same roof.
St. Louis's Most Trusted Roof Replacement Services

Coldstream Exteriors has spent over 25 years replacing roofs that perform exactly as they should. We specialize in professional roof replacement services that solve problems before they start instead of creating issues you'll fight later. We're not here to rush through your project and move to the next job. We're here to give you a properly replaced roof with quality materials, experienced installation crews, and guarantees that actually mean something.
Expert Roof Replacement for Every Situation

Many St. Louis homeowners come to us with different replacement needs. Maybe your aging asphalt shingles have finally given out after 20 years. Maybe storm damage has compromised your roof's integrity beyond repair. Maybe you're dealing with persistent leaks that patching can't fix anymore. Maybe you're upgrading to premium materials for better protection and curb appeal.

Whatever brings you here, you probably have questions. What's the best approach for your specific situation? How long will replacement take? What can you expect during the process? Will your property be protected during construction?

Here's exactly what happens. Call us for a free consultation and we'll come to your property within 24 hours to assess your project properly. We'll discuss your goals, explain your material options, answer every question thoroughly, and provide a detailed written estimate that covers everything. We've replaced hundreds of roofs across St. Louis, and we know exactly what it takes to deliver results you can count on for decades. Need immediate help? Our emergency roof repair services are available when storms strike unexpectedly.
Need more than just expert replacement? Protect your entire home with professional siding services that complement your new roof beautifully!
Our Proven St. Louis Roof Replacement Process
A Roof Replacement Process That Works
Frequently Asked Questions About Roof Replacement in St. Louis
How much does roof replacement cost in St. Louis?

Most St. Louis roof replacements range from $8,500 to $18,000, depending on your home's size, roof pitch, and material choice. A typical 2,000 square foot home with architectural shingles averages $11,000-$14,000. Complex roof systems or premium materials like metal roofing typically cost more. We provide detailed written estimates after your free consultation, and you pay nothing until replacement is 100% complete.
How long does roof replacement take in St. Louis?

Most residential roof replacements take 1-3 days with our experienced crews. Simple ranch homes can often be completed in one day, while complex two-story homes with multiple roof planes typically take 2-3 days. Weather conditions can affect the timeline, and we always wait for optimal conditions to ensure proper installation.
What roofing materials do you recommend for St. Louis homes?

Architectural asphalt shingles are most popular for St. Louis homes, lasting 25-30 years with excellent weather resistance. Metal roofing offers superior longevity (40-70 years) at a higher upfront cost. During your consultation, we show you samples and explain which materials work best for your home and budget.
Do you handle storm damage roof replacement?

Yes, we specialize in storm damage repair and insurance claim assistance throughout St. Louis. We document damage thoroughly, work directly with your insurance company, and handle the entire replacement process so you can focus on your family.
Can you install a new roof over my existing shingles?

Building code allows one layer of new shingles over existing in some situations, but we rarely recommend it. Complete tear-off and replacement lets us inspect your decking, replace damaged wood, ensure proper ventilation, and install new underlayment. This approach delivers better long-term performance and allows full manufacturer warranties.

You pay nothing until your roof replacement is 100% complete and you're satisfied. No deposit, no progress payments, no financial risk. We've earned our BBB A+ rating and 4.9 stars from 400+ customers by treating St. Louis homeowners right for over 25 years.
How do I prepare my home for roof replacement?

We handle most preparation, but homeowners should move vehicles out of the driveway, cover items in your attic with tarps, remove wall decorations that might fall from vibration, and keep children and pets inside during replacement. We'll provide a complete preparation checklist before we start.
